name: 5-Hour Corporate Pro Photo Package
description:
Includes:
• Up to 5 hours of professional photography coverage
• Color-corrected and enhanced edited images
• Multiple lenses and on-camera flash for a variety of looks
• Formal and group portraits
• Detail photos of the venue, décor, signage, cake, and overall setup
• A custom-built gallery website for easy viewing, sharing, and downloading
rules: Historical 2025 source baseline. Confirm current scope and pricing before real delivery; this is not 2026 or LKQ pricing.

name: 5-Hour Corporate Video Package
description:
Includes:
• Up to 5 hours of professional video coverage
• A polished 2–3 minute highlight video
• A separate 30-second highlight cut
• Full-length speeches recorded with professional audio pulled directly from the DJ
• Individual edited clips of each speech
• A private viewing and downloadable website for easy sharing with your team
